gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Paprika spreads its letters wide, with lowercase forms that fill the line almost like capitals. Noto Sans Phoenician then settles underneath, its s curves opening wide at both ends, so the heading's loud voice gets a modern, roomy-feeling answer.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pahl: Commanding and expressive, Paprika is the loud half here. Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi brings an approachable plain sans, with gaping mouths on the e and capitals that barely rise, which is exactly why the pairing hangs together.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Paprika lets its counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open, giving every heading a commanding, expressive presence. And Noto Sans Rejang carries on below with lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, so a long stretch of text stays open and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-runic: Loud, loose, and wide-set. Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, and Noto Sans Runic counters that with a big x-height and curves that never close back on themselves, which gives the pair its sharpest contrast.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Big, scattered letters with a commanding swagger. And Noto Sans Samaritan follows in a hefty lowercase, its curves full of daylight, so the heading shouts while the text stays approachable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Wide-spaced, expressive, and hard to ignore. Noto Sans Saurashtra keeps its capitals barely taller than their neighbors and its counters connected to the outside, a quiet foil that makes the contrast the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-sc: Big, loose letters that take over the line. Noto Sans SC sits below with chalk curves that stop well before closing and ascenders that barely clear the x-height, a plain sans that lets Paprika do all the shouting.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Commanding and a bit wild, Paprika scatters its letters. Noto Sans Sharada reads steadily beneath it, its open c forms never turning into closed rings, and its bulky lowercase keeps a long stretch of text clean and professional.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Wide-set and loud, with lowercase that fills the line. Noto Sans Siddham counters with a large central band in the text line and an s whose ends hang far from the spine, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Paprika's lowercase fills the line like capitals, spaced far apart and hard to miss. Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of text beneath it, and its size is the one worth adjusting if the page feels heavy.
